drills.title: Wheel vs. Reverse Behind Net
drills.briefing: Two forecheckers seal your strong wall. Read F1 and move the puck to open ice!
drills.coachTip: When two forecheckers chase one wall, use the net as a pick and reverse weak side.
drills.coachRule: Two on your wall? Use the net and reverse to open ice.

lessonReel.headline: Two on your wall? Use the net.

C.callout: C: Curl low toward weak-side dot

LW.callout: LW: Hold hashmark to pull F2 wide

RW.callout: RW: Post high on open weak wall

LD.callout: LD: Fake wheel, reverse behind net

RD.callout: RD: Hinge into THIS SPACE for outlet

beats.label: Beat 1 · Setup
beats.caption:
F1 chases your hip and F2 seals the strong boards.
Forcing up that wall walks straight into a trap.

beats.label: Beat 2 · Movement
beats.caption:
Carry behind the net to use the iron as a pick.
Your partner RD hinges into wide-open weak-side ice!

beats.label: Beat 3 · Execution
beats.caption:
Snap a crisp reverse pass to RD in THIS SPACE,
then hit RW flying up the open lane!

drills.title: 2-on-1 Rush: Read D1 Stick
drills.briefing: 2-on-1 rush! Attack the dot and read D1 blade—if D1 slides to block seam, rip low far-pad!
drills.coachTip: Never pre-decide on a 2-on-1. Read the defender stick: slide = shoot low far pad; commit = dish.
drills.coachRule: Defender takes the pass? Shoot low far-pad for rebounds.

lessonReel.headline: Read the stick, never guess early.

C.callout: C: Drive far post with blade on ice

LW.callout: LW: Attack dot in triple-threat posture

RW.callout: RW: Trail high slot as F3 safety

LD.callout: LD: Hold offensive blue line wide

beats.label: Beat 1 · Setup
beats.caption:
Carry down the dot lane with eyes on D1.
Keep puck on your hip so you threaten shot AND pass.

beats.label: Beat 2 · Movement
beats.caption:
D1 slides toward C and lays their stick in the seam.
That leaves THIS SPACE wide open to the net!

beats.label: Beat 3 · Execution
beats.caption:
Rip a hard shot low far-pad! Either it scores clean
or kicks a juicy rebound straight onto C tape.

drills.title: Center Lock the Defensive House
drills.briefing: Drag YOUR Teal Center to shadow the shifting slot pocket inside the House and pick off the pass!
drills.coachTip: Stay net-side inside the dots-to-posts House. Never get sucked out to the perimeter boards.
drills.coachRule: Own the House net-side to starve every slot pass.

lessonReel.headline: Own the house, starve the slot.

C.callout: C: Mirror puck inside House net-side

LW.callout: LW: Cover strong-side point D lane

RW.callout: RW: Sag to top of weak-side circle

RD.callout: RD: Protect weak post & clear rebounds

beats.label: Beat 1 · Setup
beats.caption:
Opponent F1 cycles behind your net looking to feed F2
in the dangerous Home-Plate Defensive House.

beats.label: Beat 2 · Movement
beats.caption:
As F1 wheels behind the cage, slide net-side of F2
keeping your blade inside the royal-road seam.

beats.label: Beat 3 · Execution
beats.caption:
Intercept the centering pass cleanly on your tape
and spring LW up ice on the counter-rush!

drills.title: F3 High-Slot Soft Ice Pocket
drills.briefing: LW and C battle low. Drag YOUR RW into the shifting gold THIS SPACE pocket for a one-timer!
drills.coachTip: Do not crowd your teammates in the corner. Float into quiet soft ice between defenders.
drills.coachRule: Never crowd the corner—drift into quiet slot ice.

lessonReel.headline: Open ice is made, not found.

C.callout: C: Outnumber corner 2v1 & pull D2 low

LW.callout: LW: Win wall battle & scan high slot

RW.callout: RW: Drift into THIS SPACE stick cocked

LD.callout: LD: Hold weak-side blue line ready

RD.callout: RD: Seal strong wall pinch escape

beats.label: Beat 1 · Setup
beats.caption:
LW and C outnumber the corner low, pulling both
defenders toward the puck below the hashmarks.

beats.label: Beat 2 · Movement
beats.caption:
As F3, glide quietly into THIS SPACE high between
the dots with your forehand blade loaded!

beats.label: Beat 3 · Execution
beats.caption:
LW slips the low-to-high feed straight to your tape—
bury the catch-and-release one-timer!

drills.title: Winger Wall Rim Shoulder-Check
drills.briefing: Rim coming up the boards! Tap SHOULDER CHECK before puck arrives to read D1 pinch, then chip to C!
drills.coachTip: Scan over your shoulder BEFORE the rim touches your blade so you instantly beat a pinching D.
drills.coachRule: Scan before touch: pinching D means soft chip middle.

lessonReel.headline: Scan before the puck touches tape.

C.callout: C: Curl underneath dot into speed lane

LW.callout: LW: Scan point D early, soft chip middle

RW.callout: RW: Stretch weak side to pull D2 wide

LD.callout: LD: Hard rim flat along dasher boards

RD.callout: RD: Protect House until puck exits blue

beats.label: Beat 1 · Setup
beats.caption:
LD rims the puck hard around the boards to LW.
Your back is initially turned to the blue line.

beats.label: Beat 2 · Movement
beats.caption:
Snap a quick Shoulder Check BEFORE arrival!
You spot D1 pinching down the glass—opening THIS SPACE!

beats.label: Beat 3 · Execution
beats.caption:
One-touch soft chip past pinching D1 into THIS SPACE
springing Center C on an odd-man rush!

drills.title: Retrieval Scan Under Forecheck
drills.briefing: Retrieving a dump-in! Shoulder-check before touching puck to read F1 angle, then hit open C!
drills.coachTip: Two looks going back for a dump-in tell you where F1 is angling before you touch the puck.
drills.coachRule: Check your shoulder going back to beat F1 pressure.

lessonReel.headline: Two quick looks beat fast forecheckers.

C.callout: C: Curl low-and-slow into middle pocket

LW.callout: LW: Stretch weak side to open ice

RW.callout: RW: Hold hashmark to occupy F2

RD.callout: RD: Scan over shoulder, snap to open C

beats.label: Beat 1 · Setup
beats.caption:
Puck dumps deep into your corner as RD races back.
Forecheckers are hunting right behind your shoulder!

beats.label: Beat 2 · Movement
beats.caption:
Shoulder-check reveals F1 taking away the wall rim
while Center C curls cleanly into THIS SPACE!

calloutPills.text: F1 TAKES BOARDS — C IS OPEN

beats.label: Beat 3 · Execution
beats.caption:
Deceive with your hips and snap a crisp tape-to-tape
inside pass to C skating out with speed!

drills.title: D-to-D-to-Wing Breakout Chain
drills.briefing: Map the 2-pass chain BEFORE puck arrives: tap LD (Pass #1) then LW (Pass #2) to beat F1!
drills.coachTip: Great puck-movers know Pass #1 and Pass #2 before the puck ever touches their stick.
drills.coachRule: Map two passes ahead to move forecheckers laterally.

lessonReel.headline: Think one pass ahead of pressure.

C.callout: C: Support middle lane matching speed

LW.callout: LW: Post wide in THIS SPACE at blue line

RW.callout: RW: Hold strong wall to pin F2

LD.callout: LD: Hinge open for Pass #1, snap to LW

RD.callout: RD: Quick one-touch D-to-D across to LD

beats.label: Beat 1 · Setup
beats.caption:
F1 and F2 overload the right side as the puck slides
out to RD. Strong side RW is covered.

beats.label: Beat 2 · Movement
beats.caption:
Spot the 2-pass chain early: Pass #1 across to LD,
then Pass #2 up to LW streaking into THIS SPACE!

beats.label: Beat 3 · Execution
beats.caption:
Tic-tac-toe! Moving the puck laterally beats every
forechecker and launches a clean zone exit.

drills.title: Zone Entry Give-and-Go Triangle
drills.briefing: Tap the 2-touch triangle BEFORE crossing blue: Pass #1 to C middle, Pass #2 to RW backdoor!
drills.coachTip: Pucks skate faster than legs—use a quick middle bump to open the weak-side backdoor seam.
drills.coachRule: Bump middle first to open the backdoor tap-in.

lessonReel.headline: Move the puck faster than skates.

C.callout: C: Catch Pass #1 in slot & slip backdoor

LW.callout: LW: Draw D1 at blue line, dish Pass #1

RW.callout: RW: Drive far post into THIS SPACE

LD.callout: LD: Follow entry to lock strong point

RD.callout: RD: Hold weak-side blue line balance

beats.label: Beat 1 · Setup
beats.caption:
D1 steps up at the blue line on LW while C drives
the middle dot lane and RW sprints weak side.

calloutPills.text: D1 STEPS UP AT BLUE LINE

beats.label: Beat 2 · Movement
beats.caption:
Touch #1 bumps inside to C, collapsing D2 toward
the middle and opening THIS SPACE at the back post!

calloutPills.text: CHAIN: ① C -> ② RW BACKDOOR

beats.label: Beat 3 · Execution
beats.caption:
C feathers Touch #2 across the Royal Road to RW
for an unstoppable tap-in goal!

drills.title: Puck-Watching Backdoor Breakdown
drills.briefing: Watch the opponent score, auto-rewind 3.0s, and TAP the defender who chased the puck out of the House!
drills.coachTip: Never send both defensemen into the same corner—weak-side D must protect the front of the net.
drills.coachRule: Never send two defensemen into the same corner.

lessonReel.headline: Never send two teammates to one puck.

C.callout: C: Support high-slot seam & talk to D

LW.callout: LW: Lock strong-side point shot lane

LD.callout: LD: Battle F1 1-on-1 in strong corner

RD.callout: RD: STAY HOME at weak post — never chase!

beats.label: Beat 1 · Setup
beats.caption:
LD already has F1 contained in the left corner.
RD starts in perfect position guarding the weak post.

beats.label: Beat 2 · Movement
beats.caption:
MISTAKE: RD gets puck-hypnotized and chases into
the same corner—leaving F2 wide open in THIS SPACE!

beats.label: Beat 3 · Execution
beats.caption:
FIX: RD stays anchored in the House, intercepts F1
pass on the back post, and clears cleanly!

suspects.reason: Left weak post wide open to double-team corner

drills.title: Greedy F3 Pinch Sparks 2-on-1
drills.briefing: Watch the counter-rush goal, rewind 3.0s, and TAP the greedy F3 forward who abandoned high safety!
drills.coachTip: When two forwards battle below the dots, the third forward (F3) MUST stay high above the circles.
drills.coachRule: Two forwards deep means F3 stays high.

lessonReel.headline: Two deep means F3 stays high.

C.callout: C: F2 support on strong-side loose puck

RW.callout: RW: F3 HOLD HIGH above circles as safety!

LD.callout: LD: Surf tight gap with F3 reloads

RD.callout: RD: Hinge middle when puck turns over

beats.label: Beat 1 · Setup
beats.caption:
LW (F1) and C (F2) are both already deep below the
faceoff dots battling in the corner.

calloutPills.text: F1 & F2 BOTH DEEP IN CORNER

beats.label: Beat 2 · Movement
beats.caption:
MISTAKE: RW (F3) dives greedily into the same pile,
trapping all 3 forwards behind one chip pass!

beats.label: Beat 3 · Execution
beats.caption:
FIX: RW holds high middle above the circles,
killing the breakout before an odd-man rush starts!

suspects.reason: Abandoned high-slot F3 safety with 2 teammates already deep

drills.title: 1-on-1 Blue-Line Gap & Poke
drills.briefing: Slide left/right to surf backward keeping F1 inside your green Ideal Gap Zone, then tap POKE at blue line!
drills.coachTip: Too loose surrenders the zone; too tight gets beat wide. Hold 1 stick-length and poke at the blue line!
drills.coachRule: Surf a one-stick gap and stand up at blue.

lessonReel.headline: Tight gap steals their blue line.

C.callout: C: Backcheck hard through middle dots

LW.callout: LW: Reload high to scoop poked loose puck

RW.callout: RW: Track weak-side trailer to blue line

LD.callout: LD: Surf 1-stick gap & poke at blue line

RD.callout: RD: Cover middle hinge behind partner

beats.label: Beat 1 · Setup
beats.caption:
Speedy F1 attacks through neutral ice. Match their
backward speed instead of backing into your goalie!

calloutPills.text: MATCH SPEED — DO NOT BACK IN

beats.label: Beat 2 · Movement
beats.caption:
Keep F1 inside your glowing green 1-stick Ideal Gap
right down to your defensive blue line (x=340).

beats.label: Beat 3 · Execution
beats.caption:
Fire a crisp stick-on-puck POKE at the blue line
to force an instant neutral-zone turnover!

drills.title: Outside-In Rush Angle to Glass
drills.briefing: Protect inside dots! Surf RD gap keeping attacker F1 at 1-stick range and POKE at the blue line!
drills.coachTip: Protect the middle dot lane with your body and steer the rusher toward the dasher boards.
drills.coachRule: Protect middle dots and angle rushers to boards.

lessonReel.headline: Protect middle ice, steer to glass.

C.callout: C: Sprint inside dot lane for loose puck

LW.callout: LW: Guard weak-side switch in NZ

RW.callout: RW: Seal boards behind RD stand-up

LD.callout: LD: Hinge inside to back up partner

RD.callout: RD: Hold inside shoulder & poke at x=340

beats.label: Beat 1 · Setup
beats.caption:
Opponent F1 builds speed down the right wing.
Keep your inside shoulder protecting the middle dots.

beats.label: Beat 2 · Movement
beats.caption:
Surf backward with tight 1-stick spacing so F1 runs
out of room between your blade and the glass!

beats.label: Beat 3 · Execution
beats.caption:
Snap your active stick poke right on the blue line
and transition immediately up ice!

drills.title: 4v5 PK Royal Road Seam Denial
drills.briefing: Pivot YOUR stick blade inside PK box: ignore the safe top D pass, then DEFLECT the cross-seam threat!
drills.coachTip: Penalty killers want perimeter passes! Stay disciplined and keep your blade in the Royal Road seam.
drills.coachRule: Ignore safe perimeter passes; kill the royal-road seam.

lessonReel.headline: Ignore perimeter, kill the seam pass.

C.callout: C: High PK forward denying top D lane

LW.callout: LW: Weak-side high forward box integrity

LD.callout: LD: Active stick sweeping Royal Road seam

RD.callout: RD: Tie up back-post stick net-front

beats.label: Beat 1 · Setup
beats.caption:
Power play sets up its 5v4 umbrella. F1 holds on the
left flank trying to bait your stick out of the box.

beats.label: Beat 2 · Movement
beats.caption:
Pass 1 goes high to D1 on the perimeter—LET IT GO!
Chasing outside opens the deadly backdoor seam.

calloutPills.text: HOLD STICK IN ROYAL ROAD SEAM

beats.label: Beat 3 · Execution
beats.caption:
When F1 fires cross-ice to F2, angle your blade right
through the seam to deflect & clear 200 feet!

drills.title: Low-to-High Slot Seam Sweep
drills.briefing: Sweep YOUR Center stick blade in the House: let harmless wall rim pass go, BLOCK the centering pass!
drills.coachTip: Stick on the ice takes away passing lanes; stick in the air defends nobody!
drills.coachRule: Stick on ice closes dangerous slot lanes.

lessonReel.headline: Stick on ice closes passing lanes.

C.callout: C: Sweep active blade across slot seam

LW.callout: LW: Ready for outlet on weak-side wing

RW.callout: RW: Pressure D1 point without overchasing

LD.callout: LD: Box out net-front stick inside-out

RD.callout: RD: Contain F1 in corner with body

beats.label: Beat 1 · Setup
beats.caption:
Opponent F1 works the right corner while F2 lurks
high in the slot waiting for a centering feed.

beats.label: Beat 2 · Movement
beats.caption:
F1 rims to D1 along the outside wall first—stay inside
the House and keep your blade sweeping THIS SPACE!

beats.label: Beat 3 · Execution
beats.caption:
Your active blade blocks the centering pass to F2
and sparks an instant breakout up the weak side!

drills.title: Center Low-and-Slow Breakout Curl
drills.briefing: Sketch a curved low-and-slow skating curl from YOUR C underneath the dot into gold THIS SPACE!
drills.coachTip: Centers who fly away early leave their D stranded. Curl low below the dot to catch in stride!
drills.coachRule: Curl low and slow underneath the faceoff dot.

lessonReel.headline: Curl low and slow underneath dots.

C.callout: C: Sketch low loop below dot into THIS SPACE

LW.callout: LW: Post on hashmark pulling D1 wide

RW.callout: RW: Stretch weak side for middle kick-out

LD.callout: LD: Retrieve & hit C curling in stride

RD.callout: RD: Guard House until C clears zone

beats.label: Beat 1 · Setup
beats.caption:
LD retrieves in the corner with F1 angling the boards
and D1 pinching down on winger LW.

beats.label: Beat 2 · Movement
beats.caption:
Draw a deep low-and-slow curl underneath the dot
opening your forehand blade into THIS SPACE!

beats.label: Beat 3 · Execution
beats.caption:
LD snaps an easy short pass onto your tape in full
stride—breaking the forecheck wide open!

drills.title: 3v2 Middle Drive Staying Onside
drills.briefing: LW carries across blue (x=660). Sketch C curved delay-and-drive route staying ONSIDE into THIS SPACE!
drills.coachTip: Curve along the blue line if needed to stay onside, then explode down the middle dot lane!
drills.coachRule: Straddle blue onside, then drive middle dots.

lessonReel.headline: Stay onside and drive the dots.

RW.callout: RW: High weak-side option into soft ice

beats.caption:

Do NOT cross the blue line ahead of the puck!

beats.label: Beat 2 · Movement
beats.caption:
Arc smoothly behind x=660 until LW enters, then
explode down the middle lane into THIS SPACE!

beats.label: Beat 3 · Execution
beats.caption:
Your middle drive backs both defenders off, letting
LW hit you in the slot for a prime scoring chance!

drills.title: Long Shift Dump-In: Safe Change
drills.briefing: 49s shift—legs at 89% fatigue! Teammate dumps puck deep into far corner. CHANGE NOW or STAY?
drills.coachTip: Short 45-second shifts win games! Always change when the puck goes deep into the opponent end.
drills.coachRule: Puck deep in their zone? Sprint to bench!

lessonReel.headline: Puck deep in their end? Change.

C.callout: C: Gain red line & dump deep to far corner

LW.callout: LW: Tired legs near bench — CHANGE NOW!

RW.callout: RW: Fresh leg hunts F1 on the dump-in

LD.callout: LD: Change right behind forward wave

RD.callout: RD: Hold middle ice during change transition

beats.label: Beat 1 · Setup
beats.caption:
Your shift clock hits 49s and your fatigue bar is red.
Staying out tired leads to turnovers and penalties.

beats.label: Beat 2 · Movement
beats.caption:
Center C crosses red and dumps the puck 200ft deep
into the opponent corner—zero counter-rush threat!

beats.label: Beat 3 · Execution
beats.caption:
Sprint hard to the bench door so fresh teammates
jump onto the forecheck at full speed!

drills.title: Tired Legs on 3v2 Counter Against
drills.briefing: Fatigue at 86%, BUT turnover sparks an opponent 3-on-2 straight toward your goalie! CHANGE or STAY?
drills.coachTip: A bad change on a counter-rush hands the opponent a free 3-on-1! Empty the tank back to the House first.
drills.coachRule: Never change into an odd-man rush against.

lessonReel.headline: Never change into an odd-man rush.

C.callout: C: Sprint middle lane to pick up trailer

LW.callout: LW: Backcheck hard on weak-side point

RW.callout: RW: Reload inside dots toward House

beats.label: Beat 1 · Setup
beats.caption:
You are right next to the bench door with tired legs,
but a neutral-zone turnover springs 3 attackers!

beats.label: Beat 2 · Movement
beats.caption:
Stepping off for a line change here leaves RD all
alone on a 3-on-1 breakaway! Protect THIS SPACE!

beats.label: Beat 3 · Execution
beats.caption:
Empty the tank to kill the rush first—then change
safely once your team clears the blue line!
